intensity_justification: Expansion of compiler subsystems: Cryptographic Audit Ledger, Section Relocation Boundary Verification, and Nonce-Gated Provenance Verification across PE32+ and ELF64 formats.

mandatory_gates.name: Multi-Repo Ingestion & Topological Resolution
mandatory_gates.oracle: DAG dependency resolution produces deterministic compile order with zero cycles.

mandatory_gates.name: Inter-Repository Dead Code Slicing
mandatory_gates.oracle: Unreferenced symbols across repositories are pruned with symbol conservation (before == after + pruned).

mandatory_gates.name: Native Object Linking & Relocation with Boundary Checks
mandatory_gates.oracle: Static linking applies REL32 and ADDR64 relocations across modules with 0 unresolved symbols and strict section boundary invariants.

mandatory_gates.name: Formal PE/ELF Structure & Section Alignment Verification
mandatory_gates.oracle: pefile and pyelftools verify headers, sections, machine architectures, and export tables with page alignment.

mandatory_gates.name: Independent Adversarial Fuzzing & 11/11 Mutation Kill Gate
mandatory_gates.oracle: 100% of injected mutants killed; property-based fuzzing with Hypothesis passes all memory and arithmetic invariants.

mandatory_gates.name: Code Property Graph Tenant Isolation & Taint Tracking
mandatory_gates.oracle: Zero cross-tenant dataflow taint paths from confidential sources to public sinks.

mandatory_gates.name: Pre-Flight Silicon Safety Sandbox (Unicorn CPU Emulation)
mandatory_gates.oracle: Unicorn x86-64 CPU emulation catches segmentation faults, null writes, and infinite loops prior to host execution.

mandatory_gates.name: Universal ABI Bridge & CEGIS Calling Convention Synthesis
mandatory_gates.oracle: Windows x64 and System V AMD64 calling conventions correctly marshalled with stack alignment.

mandatory_gates.name: Universal Cross-Target Binary Emission (PE32+/ELF64 x86-64/ARM64)
mandatory_gates.oracle: Direct machine code emission of Windows PE32+ (x86-64/ARM64) and Linux ELF64 (x86-64/ARM64) standalone binaries and shared libraries without external toolchains.

mandatory_gates.name: Microarchitectural Benchmark & Memory Stability
mandatory_gates.oracle: x86-64 JIT achieves >100x speedup vs CPython; 0 memory leaks across 100 DLL Load/Free cycles (+0.00 MB delta).

mandatory_gates.name: Cryptographic Audit Ledger & Nonce-Gated Provenance Verification
mandatory_gates.oracle: Cryptographic HMAC/SHA-256 audit ledger with nonce authentication validates compilation lineage and rejects tampered artifacts.
